plain_claim: In the heap model, let c be a command, hb a heap, a an address and w a value. tier_justification: Small folklore facts made precise to delimit R1-R4; not claimed novel.
plain_claim: (i) The Hoare conjunction rule holds for every command without precision or cancellativity. (ii) A local heap command can terminate from emp and have no outcome from every non-empty heap. (iii) With empty disjointness every command is local and every assertion precise, with unique frames and the distribution law; without a unit even the always-true assertion can be precise. (iv) Right- and left-handed precision and distribution coincide under symmetric disjointness and commutative union, and can differ without them, even in cancellative structures. (v) A heap command that is safe on emp and faults from some heap is not safety-monotone. (vi) Over the uninhabited value type Empty the only heap is emp, so every heap command is safety-monotone and has the frame property; the non-locality results need an inhabited value type.
